newsitem.title: UK: IBCA to review Korean bank and sovereign ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA to review Korean bank and sovereign ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Tuesday it would review its Korean bank and sovereign ratings, following the announcement the KIA Group in Korea is seeking protection for some of its subsidiaries.
IBCA noted it had recently lowered a number of Korean bank ratings but that the problems of KIA would place further pressures on an already over-extended banking system.
"Once it has full details of the likely impact of this most recent problem, IBCA will assess whether further downgrades are necessary," IBCA said in a statement.

It said in the case of the sovereign rating, the agency would be conducting its annual review of Korea in the next month. "It will take this opportunity to assess whether the economic fundamentals of Korea are strong enough to deal with the mounting banking problems," it said.
